The child adapts that machinery to an appointment authorized by legislation and adds implementation and enclosure details. C24 and C15 share similar ceremonial pleasure language, but neither concerns an appointment and thus offer only weaker, conventional parallels.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"It gives me a great deal of pleasure to inform you that I have today approved the Act of Congress authorizing your appointment","parent_excerpt":"It gives me a great deal of satisfaction to appoint you Chairman of this Committee.","explanation":"Distinctively close wording performs the same central function: personally notifying the recipient of a presidential appointment."},{"child_excerpt":"The legislation constitutes a reaffirmation of the affection and regard of our Nation for you.","parent_excerpt":"Under your leadership, I am convinced that this group can make a major and timely contribution to the economic and social welfare of the nation and to the national security as well.","explanation":"Both follow the appointment announcement with a concise statement connecting the appointment to national esteem or public benefit."}]}
